What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[They're Tracking Us (V)]]: left, the image of [[They're Tracking Us (V) (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit a41bae9); right, the image of [[They're Tracking Us (V) (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit a57375e).
